description: This file implements the MediaPipelineCapabilitiesModuleService class and related factory functions for managing media pipeline capabilities, including methods for client connection handling and MIME type support queries within an IPC framework.

classes.name: IMediaPipelineCapabilitiesModuleServiceFactory
classes.description: Interface for creating MediaPipelineCapabilitiesModuleService factory instances.

classes.name: MediaPipelineCapabilitiesModuleServiceFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of MediaPipelineCapabilitiesModuleService.

classes.name: MediaPipelineCapabilitiesModuleService
classes.description: Service class providing media pipeline capabilities, including MIME type support queries and client connection management.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new IMediaPipelineCapabilitiesModuleServiceFactory instance.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new MediaPipelineCapabilitiesModuleService instance, given a media pipeline service reference.

methods.name: MediaPipelineCapabilitiesModuleService
methods.description: Constructor initializing the service with a media pipeline service reference.

methods.name: clientConnected
methods.description: Handles a new client connection, exporting the service to the client.

methods.name: getSupportedMimeTypes
methods.description: Handles a request to retrieve supported MIME types for a given media source type.

methods.name: isMimeTypeSupported
methods.description: Handles a request to check if a specific MIME type is supported.
